content_review.definitions_and_timing: Liquidity, solvency, rollover, collateral haircuts versus creditor haircuts, leverage, sudden stop, resolution and decision criteria defined before use. H and F currencies distinguished; all FX flows occur after revaluation. Bank amounts are undiscounted terminal residuals, while fiscal claim value explicitly uses a date-1 discount.
content_review.bank: Read and independently reconciled initial book, withdrawal cash, full-pay sale and bridge, bad recovery, seniority, creditor loss, cancelled old ownership and public injection. Negative net worth is retained; cancellation alone never erases liabilities. Numerical sale price restricted to full-pay state. Lab restricts bad-state pre-support net worth to at most zero.
content_review.collateral: Derived H globally and proved minimum crossing satisfies nonnegative remaining debt; verified endpoint/vertex maximum and all three main branches, including full liquidation and no repair. Uniform-price receipts stated; no integral-of-demand confusion. Lab separately flags upper-bracket nonnegative debt.
content_review.external: Cash calendar and CA/FA/NFA bridge independently checked by c11 author and root outline review. Gross maturing principal separated from interest/earned income and new lending. Quote H/F and revaluation-before-flows prevent double conversion and transaction/valuation overlap. National cash pooling explicitly assumed, not inferred.
content_review.sovereign: Both dates, gross issuance versus net stock change and finite present-value equivalence checked. Pre-support primary cash surplus explicitly different from post-transfer statistical illustration. Claim acquisition and transfer sum to cash outlay; positive terminal payoff is discounted once at date 1. No unproved infinite-horizon or universal safe-debt claim.
content_review.historical: Actual official primary bodies inspected for Korea 1997 and United States 2007–09, with publication/testimony dates and participant/evaluator attribution. No numerical country calibration, chronology-as-identification or current legal claim. Source record scopes distinguish accessible technical-assistance application from unavailable full GFSM retrieval.
content_review.solutions: All eight prompts read against complete solutions. Exact exercises1–5 and8 independently recomputed; all expected-loss crossings and ties, minimax loss and regret checked for6. Open7 gives explicit reasoning failures and affirmative evaluation criteria. Teach-back checklist and retention answers supplied.
content_review.instruction: Prerequisite links, explicit assumptions/units/domain boundaries, global certificates, worked cases, linked lab stress, decision protocol, critique, teach-back and delayed answers inspected. Forward Volume6/7 routes use curriculum anchors; no unwritten successor represented as complete.

resolved_findings.finding: Cancelling old bank shares must not reset the negative net-worth residual.
resolved_findings.resolution: Explicit −10 residual before injection; 15 cash injection produces residual5 and old cancellation makes no liability adjustment.

resolved_findings.finding: A cash injection for an impaired claim cannot automatically all be classified as financial acquisition.
resolved_findings.resolution: S1^0 marks pre-support primary cash; fair-value illustration a=50/11, transfer115/11, post-transfer S1=−71/11 and A1=−16/11 jointly give debt93. Source scope and instrument/valuation limits explicit.

resolved_findings.finding: Uniform sale receipts and nonnegative remaining debt must be part of collateral model.
resolved_findings.resolution: Both constraints explicit; first-crossing proof establishes feasibility; numerical brackets expose separate debt-domain check.

resolved_findings.finding: Initial checker description said96 collateral cases though grid contains48.
resolved_findings.resolution: Count corrected to48; returned count and prose now agree.

resolved_findings.resolution: Display now states B′ >= 0 separately and restricts the equivalence to the collateral inequality. The first-crossing proof still verifies both constraints.
